name: asb1_canary_v2_bull_swap_v1
description: Pair-4: ASB1 (alt_support_bounce_v1) sweep targeting bull_chop and bull_trend regimes specifically. Goal: prove that ASB1 in bull regimes outperforms ARF1 in bull regimes (ARF1 caused the only red month in canary v2 — happened in bull_chop). If ASB1 wins, propose regime-split: ARF1 active in bear_chop/bear_trend, ASB1 active in bull_chop/bull_trend.
_goal: Find ASB1 params that work specifically in bull-leaning conditions, to swap with ARF1 in bull_chop/bull_trend regimes via regime-overlay.
_pair_strategy: If best ASB1 net > 8 with PF >= 1.30 — proceed to additivity test: replace flat→bounce1 in bull_chop overlay, run dynamic 360d canary v2 vs canary v2 + ASB1-bull-swap. Decision rule: keep swap if (a) red month gone or smaller, (b) net not lower than baseline, (c) DD no worse by more than +1.0pp.
